thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Performance alert (INC-2026-034) — elevated latency observed across EU inference routing cluster since 03:42 UTC. Metric: regional latency spike; top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Auto-escalation to oncall.

maria (oncall): Acknowledged, taking ownership. Jumping in to triage.

raj (eng-sre): On it — grabbing stats now. Seeing a routing weight shift to hostpool-legacy-3 and 4, queue length up ~4x on those nodes.

kevin (infra): Alert shows node oom/kube-eviction events about 03:38 on a couple hosts, but they recovered. Might be correlated with a config rollout earlier today.

maria (oncall): Any recent routing config changes? @kevin did we push any traffic-weights or canary rules around 03:30?

kevin (infra): Yes — small canary to adjust regional weights (ops-2026-03-12-routing). It was intended to move 5% traffic; looks like the rollout mis-evaluated and reached 35% due to a deployment glitch. Investigating rollback.

raj (eng-sre): Quick mitigation options: 1) rollback routing rollout (preferred) 2) temporarily reduce worker concurrency on legacy pool 3) enable fallback to compact/quant model variant for EU to reduce token compute. Which do we want as primary?

maria (oncall): Rollback first. Kevin, can you push a rollback to restore pre-rollout weights? If it takes >5m, enable fallback (option 3) as temporary. I'll draft a status update for customers.

kevin (infra): Rolling back now. Command: 
```
kubectl apply -f /deploy/routing/ops-2026-03-11-weights.yaml
```
Started at 03:46 UTC.

ops-bot: deployment/ops-2026-03-11-weights applied — rollout initiated.

raj (eng-sre): Monitoring queue lengths and p95. Initial numbers: p95 eu /v1/chat = 1.12s -> target baseline 220ms. Hoping rollback restores within one rollout window (~2m).

sophie (support): Draft for status page / customer comms: 
"We are investigating elevated inference latency impacting EU customers on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Engineers are rolling back a routing change and applying mitigations. No data loss. We will provide updates within 15 minutes."

maria (oncall): Good start. Add: affected time, impacted endpoints, suggested workaround: retry with region=us for critical requests. Also include contact for enterprise customers.

sophie (support): Updated draft: 
"Starting ~03:42 UTC, some EU inference requests are experiencing increased response times. We are rolling back a routing change and expect service restoration within ~10 minutes. If you need immediate low-latency service, please route requests to the US region as a workaround. Enterprise customers: reach out to your CSM or support@redwood.ai for priority assistance."

raj (eng-sre): Rollback completed at 03:48 UTC per kevin. Seeing immediate drop in queue length on legacy pool. p95 is trending down: 1.12s -> 420ms and dropping.

kevin (infra): Follow-up: found a bug in the rollout controller that double-applied a step when API returned timeout. Patching controller now. Will open a follow-up PR and schedule hotfix.

maria (oncall): Good catch. Please create incident follow-up ticket for controller hotfix and postmortem. Tag: eng-infra, eng-sre.

kevin (infra): Created ticket INFRA-2026-298. PR linked.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-034 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria (oncall): Status page copy for the update (please review): 
"Update 03:50 UTC — We rolled back a routing change that caused elevated latency for EU inference routes. We've observed p95 latency return towards normal and will continue monitoring. Root cause: routing rollout controller bug caused unintended traffic shift. A follow-up investigation and fix are in progress. No customer data was affected."

sophie (support): Reviewed and posted to status page.

raj (eng-sre): Continued monitoring: p95 now at 260ms, p50 stable. Keeping buffers open.

maria (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll stay on incident for next 30m to watch stability, then hand to oncall follow for postmortem. @raj please collect detailed metrics (traffic weights, queue lengths, host-level metrics) and attach to INFRA-2026-298.

raj (eng-sre): Will attach logs and timeframe. Also saving snapshot of rollout controller logs and the operator events.

kevin (infra): Hotfix PR created and flagged for review. If all good we'll merge and deploy out-of-band tonight to prevent reoccurrence.

sophie (support): Sent an outbound email to affected accounts (small subset) with the customer-friendly summary and link to status page.

maria (oncall): Closing notes: mitigation successful, p95 back within acceptable range, monitoring for 30 more minutes. If anything regresses, page again. Leaving INC-2026-034 open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INC-2026-034 moved to monitoring at 03:52 UTC.
